title: Teams
intro: The teams of your organization. Everyone can see them and who manages each; administrators create, edit and delete teams.
notFound: This team does not exist (or was deleted).
managerHint: The person who manages the team.
deleteConflict: This team is still referenced elsewhere and cannot be deleted yet.
saveConflict: A team with this name already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This team no longer exists — reload the page

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters

view.noMilestones: This team has no milestones yet
view.noMilestonesHint: Milestones are added on their project's page and assigned to a team there.
view.criticalNote: Slack and the critical path are measured toward the end of the milestone's own project. A dependency is marked only when it lies on the chain of a project this team works on.

announce.reset: The order was reset to the project rank

view.orderStale: The team's order changed in the meantime — the list was reloaded. Your last change was not saved; make it again if you still want it.
view.orderForbidden: Only the team's manager or an administrator can change the order
view.resetBody: The team's own order is dropped and the milestones follow the project rank again (the order of the Roadmap).
view.saveForbidden: Only the team's manager or an administrator can change the capacity
view.saveGone: This no longer exists — reload the page
view.saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid — check the date, the man-days and the WIP limit
view.capacityIntro: Man-days per week from the date each period takes effect, until the next period. The optional WIP limit is the most milestones in progress on one working day. Overload and WIP warn only — nothing moves.
view.noCapacityHint: Add a period to compare each week's load with the team's capacity.
view.noCapacityHintReadOnly: The team's manager or an administrator sets the capacity.
view.weeklyIntro: Columns are the week's load, the line the team's capacity; orange marks an overloaded week, a dashed mark a week over the WIP limit. Both only warn — nothing moves.
view.weeklyEmpty: Nothing is scheduled yet, so there is no weekly load.
view.weeklyTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} weeks of the schedule.

period.effectiveFromHint: The first day this capacity applies. A weekend date applies from the Monday after it; earlier periods stay as history.
period.mdPerWeekHint: The team's capacity for a full week, in steps of a half day. Zero puts the team on hold.
period.wipLimitHint: The most milestones in progress on one working day, 1 to 99. Leave empty for no limit.
period.dateTaken: Another period starts on this date
period.deleteBody: The period from {{date}} will be deleted; the weeks it covered take the capacity of the period before it.

validation.manDays: Enter man-days from 0, with at most two decimals
validation.wipLimit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 99, or leave empty for no limit

proposal.title: Proposed schedule
proposal.intro: Dashed bars on the timeline show the proposed dates. Link warnings and the proposed load follow the moves you tick. Nothing changes until you accept.
proposal.checkFailed: The ticked moves could not be checked; the warnings describe all moves.

summary.pinned_one: {{count}} milestone keeps its dates because it is pinned
summary.pinned_other: {{count}} milestones keep their dates because they are pinned

proposal.readOnly: A proposal is open, so the schedule is read-only — discard it first, then make your change.
proposal.nothing: Nothing to propose: every milestone has started or stays where it is.
proposal.noCapacity: Nothing could be placed: the team has no capacity after {{date}} — add a capacity period first.
proposal.forbidden: Only the team's manager or an administrator can propose a schedule
proposal.gone: This team no longer exists — reload the page
proposal.invalid: The proposal could not be applied — propose again
proposal.stale: The plan changed in the meantime — the schedule was reloaded. Nothing was saved; propose again.
proposal.rescoped: The team's plan changed since the proposal: here is a fresh one. Your selection was kept for the milestones that still move.

reason.noWorkingDay: no working day left in the span

links.violatesSuccessorStart: would violate: {{name}} must start on {{date}} or later
links.violatesSuccessorEnd: would violate: {{name}} must end on {{date}} or later
links.violatesPredecessorStart: would violate: must start on {{date}} or later (link from {{name}})
links.violatesPredecessorEnd: would violate: must end on {{date}} or later (link from {{name}})
